Note: The bidder has to comply with the eligibility criteria or else their offer shall be summarily rejected. 2) The bidder should have average annual turnover of ₹ 1 lakhs during the financial year 2023-24, 2024-20 25 and 2025-26. Bidders has to submit CA certified turnover details for the financial year 2023-24, 2024-2 025 and 2025-26. 3) DP will be for 180 days from the placement of supply order. 4) MSEs and Startup firms are exempted from experience and turnover criteria. As per the latest order issued by Ministry of MSME, if a bidder is a Micro or small Enterprise (MSE) then the bidder shall be relaxed from experience criteria & bidder turnover subject to meeting of quality and techni cal specification.
